R1: Make the intended outcome and the next observable check concrete before expensive work.
R2: Test assumptions with the smallest relevant experiment before committing to a large build.
R3: Judge success on the surface the person actually uses, not on an agent's completion claim.
R4: Preserve the latest explicit human intent; a missing note is not a missing intention.
R5: Match delegation and scope to the task; use explicit handoffs and verify returned artifacts.
R6: Separate observed outcomes, assistant reports, unknowns, and hypothetical alternatives.
R7: Turn a recurring failure into a checkable procedure, then test whether the change helps.
